label: July 27 – August 2, 2026
intro: Double public holiday mid-week — Asalha Bucha (Wednesday July 29) and Khao Phansa (Thursday July 30) open up precious weekday time for temple magic and workshop adventures.

activities.title: Asalha Bucha Candle Ceremony
activities.time: Morning ceremonies from 7am; evening candlelight from 6:30pm
activities.location: Wat Pho or Wat Arun, Rattanakosin Island
activities.price: Wat Arun entry ~100 THB; Wat Pho ~200 THB adults, free under 10
activities.why: Thousands of candles, monks in golden procession, spires glowing over the Chao Phraya — an Asalha Bucha ceremony is genuinely magical for a 5-year-old. Cross the river on a long-tail boat for extra adventure points.
activities.tip: Morning is cooler and calmer; the evening candlelight ceremony (after 6:30pm) is more spectacular. Grab iced thai tea and satay from the riverside vendors after.

activities.title: Holiday Workshop Day at Toob North — Cloud 11
activities.price: Free to browse; workshop sessions priced individually
activities.why: Two mid-week holidays = prime workshop time without burning a weekend. Northern makers from Chiang Mai are still in residence — potters, weavers, and food artisans. Perfect building & making outing.
activities.tip: Holiday weekdays are busier than normal weekdays but less crowded than true weekends. Get there at opening.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24
activities.why: After a mid-week holiday, the August 1–2 weekend is a great reset — get Thor back on wheels at SE Asia's biggest indoor roller rink. Coaches on hand for beginners, practice grass area included.
activities.tip: Post-holiday weekends can be busy — arrive at 10am opening to skate in peace.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.location: Mega Bangna (BTS On Nut + Grab, ~30 min)
activities.why: Holiday week = perfect Marvel window. Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D dome, VR flight training, and meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor the Avenger, Hulk, and Spider-Man. If you haven't gone yet, this is the week.
activities.tip: Book on Klook ahead of time — Asalha Bucha holiday weekend can sell out. Allow 2–2.5 hours.

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Bonbon Chocolate Workshop
activities.price: Check website for current session price
activities.why: Small-group kids chocolate workshop — Thor gets to make his own bonbons with real Thai craft chocolate and take them home. A guaranteed winner for a making-obsessed 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Dates go fast — check kadkokoa.co now and book August slots while they're open. Follow their LINE Official for new date alerts.
